narrative: The Dev Box pitch is local-prototype-to-cloud: it runs 120B-plus models at a million-token context locally and bundles a Foundry stack documenting a path up to cloud deployment, the local-by-default-then-spill shape the prediction names. The gap is that this handoff is a deploy pipeline, not runtime overflow, and it is a hardware workstation, not a harness spilling to cloud by default.
remaining_gap: A coding-agent harness that runs local by default and automatically spills inference to cloud as runtime overflow under a standardized setting, not a deploy pipeline.
